text.autoconfig.eatingpace.title: Eating Pace Settings
text.autoconfig.eatingpace.option.enable: Use custom food values for eating pace
text.autoconfig.eatingpace.option.eating: Speed multiplier for eating (0.5 = half speed, 2.0 = double speed)
text.autoconfig.eatingpace.option.enable: Master switch for all interruption types
text.autoconfig.eatingpace.option.fireIn: Stop eating when taking fire or lava damage
text.autoconfig.eatingpace.option.poison: Stop eating when poisoned or withered
text.autoconfig.eatingpace.option.fallIn: Stop eating when taking fall damage
text.autoconfig.eatingpace.option.suffoc: Stop eating when suffocating in blocks
text.autoconfig.eatingpace.option.starva: Stop eating when taking starvation damage
text.autoconfig.eatingpace.option.meleeI: Stop eating when hit by melee attacks
text.autoconfig.eatingpace.option.projec: Stop eating when hit by arrows, etc.
text.autoconfig.eatingpace.option.explos: Stop eating when hit by explosions
